items.question: Who is this program for?
items.answer: Python developers, software engineers, AI/ML engineers, data scientists, full-stack developers and technical professionals moving into modern production AI.

items.question: What makes this different from prompt engineering courses?
items.answer: If you want to move beyond surface-level prompting and build production-grade agentic systems, fine-tuned LLMs and cloud-native AI pipelines, this program is designed for you.

items.question: Who is the instructor?
items.answer: The lead instructor is Mian Ahmad Basit, supported by experienced engineers from the faculty.

items.question: Do I need advanced AI experience before joining?
items.answer: No. The roadmap starts with Python, math, ML, deep learning and NLP foundations before moving into transformers, LLM fine-tuning, RAG, agents, security and cloud deployment.

items.question: Will we write real production code?
items.answer: Yes. The program focuses on production Python, FastAPI services, Dockerized systems, vector databases, agent orchestration, guardrails, observability and cloud deployment patterns.

items.question: Which LLMs and model providers are covered?
items.answer: OpenAI GPT-4o and o-series models, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1 and V3, Meta LLaMA 3.1/3.3, Google Gemini, Hugging Face models, Ollama and vLLM.

items.question: Does the program include RAG and GraphRAG?
items.answer: Yes. You cover hybrid RAG, Self-RAG, Corrective RAG, Adaptive RAG, ColPali multimodal RAG, Neo4j GraphRAG, vector search, reranking, retrieval security and evaluation.

items.question: Will I learn AI agents and multi-agent systems?
items.answer: Yes. The curriculum includes LangGraph, PydanticAI, MCP, A2A protocols, tool calling, supervisor agents, state checkpointing, human-in-the-loop workflows and agent observability.

items.question: Is fine-tuning included?
items.answer: Yes. You learn SFT, LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA, DPO, GRPO, ORPO, quantization, synthetic datasets, PEFT workflows and open-weight model deployment.

items.question: Does this cover AI security?
items.answer: Yes. Security topics include prompt injection defense, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, Microsoft Presidio PII masking, LlamaFirewall, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, RBAC and private VPC deployment.

items.question: Will we deploy systems to cloud infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. Deployment topics include Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, AWS EKS, GCP, Azure, VPS hosting and production observability.

items.question: Are n8n and automation workflows included?
items.answer: Yes. You learn self-hosted n8n workflow automation, webhooks, FastMCP tool nodes, agent workflows and enterprise automation patterns.

items.question: Does the program include computer vision and multimodal AI?
items.answer: Yes. The curriculum covers ViT, CLIP, SigLIP, DINOv2, LLaVA, Qwen-2-VL, VLMs, image understanding, multimodal retrieval and video/document processing.

items.question: Are recordings or LMS access included?
items.answer: Yes. The program includes 2 years of dedicated LMS access with recordings, repositories, notebooks, slide decks, quizzes and periodic content updates.

items.question: What kind of projects will I build?
items.answer: Production RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, secure AI APIs, fine-tuning notebooks, vector database systems, n8n automations, guardrail-enabled assistants and cloud-deployed AI services.

items.question: Can this help with freelancing or consulting?
items.answer: Yes. The program includes career and business guidance for AI consulting, Upwork and LinkedIn positioning, proposal templates, pricing models, retainers and AI agency workflows.

items.question: Is this suitable for full-stack developers?
items.answer: Yes. Full-stack developers can use this program to move from app development into AI SaaS, agentic automation products, RAG platforms and cloud-native AI systems.

items.question: Is this suitable for ML engineers?
items.answer: Yes. ML engineers can deepen their skills in transformer internals, fine-tuning, model serving, LLMOps, evaluation, observability, RAG security and production deployment.

items.question: What tools are used for observability and evaluation?
items.answer: LangSmith, Langfuse, Logfire, RAGAS, Inspect AI, Pydantic Evals, lm-eval, token budgeting, semantic caching, tracing and score-gated deployment.

items.question: How long is the program?
items.answer: It is a deep 7-8 month engineering specialization with a complete progression from foundations to production AI architecture.

items.question: Do I get mentorship from Mian Ahmad Basit?
items.answer: Yes. You get direct guidance, live weekend sessions, code review checkpoints, architecture blueprints and mentorship from Mian Ahmad Basit.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate?
items.answer: Yes. Students who complete the required learning and project milestones receive an official verified certificate of completion from the instructor.

items.question: Can beginners join?
items.answer: Yes, if you are willing to follow the Phase 0 foundations seriously. The program starts from Python and AI foundations and moves into advanced production engineering.

items.question: What is the end goal of the program?
items.answer: To move you from toy demos to shipping secure, evaluated, observable, cloud-deployed AI systems for jobs, freelancing, consulting and product development.

phases.title: Programming & AI Foundations
phases.description: Python fundamentals, object-oriented design, async concurrency and the project engineering prerequisites required for AI systems.

modules.title: Python Syntax & Core Fundamentals
modules.subtitle: Deep dive into Python language constructs, data structures and memory mechanics.
modules.overview: Build production-grade Python foundations covering syntax, data structures, functions, exceptions, file handling, environments, packages and dependency management.
modules.keyOutcome: Build clean Python projects using production-grade syntax, data structures, packaging and dependency management.

modules.title: Object-Oriented & Advanced Python Paradigms
modules.subtitle: Advanced OOP principles, metaprogramming, type hints and asynchronous Python.
modules.overview: Master advanced Python mechanics including object-oriented programming, iterators, generators, decorators, typing, dataclasses, asynchronous execution, REST APIs and project engineering.
modules.keyOutcome: Engineer asynchronous, typed and modular Python services ready for AI workloads.

phases.title: Machine Learning Foundations
phases.description: Complete mathematical foundations (linear algebra, calculus, statistics) and classical supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms.
phases.milestone: Train, Evaluate & Serialize Classical ML Models

modules.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
modules.subtitle: The exact mathematical concepts that power vector spaces, optimization loss landscapes and probabilistic models.
modules.overview: Build the mathematical intuition required to understand optimization, neural networks and modern AI systems.
modules.keyOutcome: Build the mathematical intuition behind optimization and probabilistic modeling used across AI systems.

modules.title: Classical Machine Learning Algorithms & Engineering
modules.subtitle: Supervised and unsupervised learning, ensemble methods, feature engineering and model evaluation.
modules.overview: Master classical machine learning algorithms alongside the feature engineering and evaluation practices required to ship reliable models.
modules.keyOutcome: Train, evaluate and serialize classical ML models with production-grade pipelines.

phases.title: Deep Learning Foundations
phases.description: Neural network architectures, forward and backpropagation, loss landscapes, PyTorch mechanics, CNNs and sequence models.

modules.title: Neural Networks & Optimization Mechanics
modules.subtitle: Perceptrons, multi-layer networks, backpropagation calculus and optimization algorithms.
modules.overview: Understand neural network mechanics from perceptrons through backpropagation, optimizers and regularization.
modules.keyOutcome: Trace a neural network from forward propagation through backpropagation and modern optimization.

modules.title: PyTorch, CNNs & Sequence Models
modules.subtitle: Hands-on PyTorch engineering, convolutional networks for vision and recurrent architectures for sequences.
modules.overview: Engineer models in PyTorch and understand convolutional and recurrent architectures for vision and sequence data.
modules.keyOutcome: Build and train CNNs and sequence models in PyTorch, ready for Transformer architectures.

phases.title: NLP Foundations
phases.description: Classical text preprocessing, vector embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe) and sequence modeling for NLP downstream tasks.
phases.milestone: Represent Text as Dense Vector Spaces

modules.title: NLP Core Concepts & Vector Spaces
modules.subtitle: Text representation techniques from lexical features to dense continuous vector spaces.
modules.overview: Master classical NLP preprocessing, representation and downstream tasks that lead directly into Transformers.
modules.keyOutcome: Build classical NLP pipelines and understand the representations that lead directly into Transformers.

phases.title: AI Foundations & Transformers 101
phases.description: Deep dive into Transformers, self-attention and full tokenization strategies (BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece).

modules.title: Transformers 101 & Attention Mechanism
modules.subtitle: Embeddings, self-attention and Transformer architectures.
modules.overview: Understand the mathematics and implementation of modern Transformer blocks from embeddings through attention and positional encoding.
modules.keyOutcome: Implement and mathematically trace a Transformer attention block from embeddings through attention outputs.

modules.title: Tokenization Deep Dive
modules.subtitle: BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece and byte-level tokenization.
modules.overview: Understand how modern LLM tokenizers convert raw text into token IDs and handle vocabulary construction, subwords and edge cases.
modules.keyOutcome: Build and analyze tokenizers while understanding exactly how text becomes model input tokens.

phases.title: Prompts to Programs & Programmatic LLMs
phases.description: Advanced prompt engineering, Pydantic structured schemas, Outlines FSA grammars and DSPy programmatic pipeline optimization.

modules.title: Advanced Prompt Engineering Strategies
modules.subtitle: Systematic prompt design, chain-of-thought, meta-prompting and output enforcement.
modules.overview: Design robust production prompts using systematic prompting strategies, decomposition, structured outputs and iterative refinement.
modules.keyOutcome: Design reliable production prompts instead of relying on ad-hoc prompt experimentation.

modules.title: Instructor, Pydantic & Outlines for Typed Outputs
modules.subtitle: Guarantee 100% schema-compliant responses using typed validation contracts and token masking.
